label: Generate PDF
description: Renders a polished PDF from a built-in template (invoice, report, letter, certificate, proposal, one-pager) or your own custom HTML/CSS. Rendering runs on the cloud render service and is metered in credits; the node calls it from your site, so a connected account is required.

config.name: sourceMode
config.description: Choose a built-in template or render your own custom HTML/CSS.

config.name: template
config.description: Built-in template id (used when sourceMode = template).

config.name: templateData
config.description: Map of template field (dot-path) => value. Values may contain workflow variable tags; JSON values are parsed for array/object fields.

config.name: customHtml
config.description: Custom HTML/CSS document to render (used when sourceMode = custom). Scripts/iframes are stripped by the renderer.

consumes.note: templateData maps each template field (dot-path) to its own value/tag; customHtml takes one HTML blob.
